footer.description: DimaScore delivers real-time football scores, results and standings from hundreds of leagues, cups and tournaments around the world. Follow live match events, lineups, statistics and player ratings across Europe, Africa, the Americas and Asia — from domestic leagues to the Champions League, continental cups and the World Cup. Track your favourite teams and players and get every result the moment it happens.

botolaSeasonOpener.metaTitle: Botola Pro 2026/27 calendar: season starts 24 Sep | DimaScore
botolaSeasonOpener.metaDescription: Botola Pro Inwi 2026/27 starts Thursday 24 September 2026 (LNFP). Season-start date, round-level posters, live fixtures and standings. Free, no odds. Kickoffs in your local timezone.
botolaSeasonOpener.lead: The Ligue nationale de football professionnel (LNFP) set the Botola Pro Inwi 2026/27 kickoff for Thursday 24 September 2026. This page answers the start date, lists early-season posters, and embeds live 2026/27 fixtures and the table. Free coverage, no betting odds. Kickoff times use your device timezone.
botolaSeasonOpener.startDateBody: The league resumes on Thursday 24 September 2026, per the LNFP calendar. DimaScore does not invent kickoffs: until a time is confirmed in site data, we show “kickoff to confirm”.
botolaSeasonOpener.j1Body: Matchday 1 is scheduled across 24, 26 and 27 September 2026 to fit the international window. We do not assign any pairing to a specific day until that date is confirmed in the site calendar.
botolaSeasonOpener.fixturesEmpty: 2026/27 fixtures will appear here once ingested. Until then, follow the calendar on the competition page.
botolaSeasonOpener.standingsEmpty: The 2026/27 table will appear here once matchdays are played.
botolaSeasonOpener.widgetNote: Widget kickoffs use your device timezone. A 00:00 clock or a clearly wrong date is not an official time — treat it as “kickoff to confirm” until the data updates.
botolaSeasonOpener.followBody: The widgets above are bound to the 2026/27 season. For the full calendar and table, open the Botola Pro competition page (Fixtures and Standings tabs). The Morocco edition and DimaScore home also cover Moroccan football.
botolaSeasonOpener.vsNewsTitle: This page is not a news flash
botolaSeasonOpener.vsNewsBody: Start-date announcements circulate in the press. Here the official LNFP date stays visible, posters stay round-level (no invented kickoffs), and the fixtures/standings widgets update with the 2026/27 season.
botolaSeasonOpener.faq1a: Thursday 24 September 2026, according to the LNFP.
botolaSeasonOpener.faq2q: Why isn’t matchday 1 a single day?
botolaSeasonOpener.faq2a: Matchday 1 spans 24, 26 and 27 September 2026 because of the international window. Each match’s day will show once it is confirmed in the site calendar.
botolaSeasonOpener.faq3a: Wydad vs Raja is scheduled for matchdays 11 and 26. Kickoff times remain to confirm.
botolaSeasonOpener.faq4q: Where can I follow fixtures and the table?
botolaSeasonOpener.faq4a: On this page (2026/27 widgets) and on the Botola Pro competition page, Fixtures and Standings tabs.

botolaClassement.metaDescription: Live Botola Pro Inwi 2026/27 table — the same standings as the competition Standings tab. Free, no odds. Season start date and posters on the calendar page.
botolaClassement.lead: Live Botola Pro Inwi 2026/27 standings — the same table as the Standings tab on the competition page. Free coverage, no betting odds. Before matchday 1, clubs may sit on 0 points. For the LNFP start date and posters, open the 2026/27 calendar.
botolaClassement.tableEmpty: The 2026/27 table will appear here once ingested. A pre-matchday-1 table with 0 points is expected.
botolaClassement.howToReadBody: Botola Pro Inwi has 16 clubs over 30 matchdays (home and away). Columns: played, won, drawn, lost, goal difference, goals, form, points. CAF and relegation zones, when the feed provides them, show as footnotes under the table — DimaScore does not invent competition rules.
botolaClassement.ctaBody: For the full fixture list, open the Matches tab on the competition page. The LNFP start date and early-season posters are on the 2026/27 calendar page.
botolaClassement.followBody: This table is bound to the 2026/27 season, like the Standings tab on the Botola Pro competition page. The Morocco edition and DimaScore home also cover Moroccan football.
botolaClassement.vsNewsTitle: This page is not a “standings of the day” flash
botolaClassement.vsNewsBody: Daily standings round-ups circulate in the press. Here the table updates with the site’s live data, without odds, and points to Matches and the calendar for dates.
botolaClassement.faq1q: Where does this table come from?
botolaClassement.faq1a: It is the same live Botola Pro 2026/27 standings as the Standings tab on the competition page.
botolaClassement.faq2q: Why are all clubs on 0 points?
botolaClassement.faq2a: Before matchday 1, a 0-point table is expected. Rows fill in as matchdays are played and ingested.
botolaClassement.faq3a: Thursday 24 September 2026, according to the LNFP. Details and posters are on the calendar page.
botolaClassement.faq4a: On the Botola Pro competition page Matches tab, and on the 2026/27 calendar landing.

botola2Classement.tableEmpty: The Botola 2 table will appear here once ingested.
botola2Classement.howToReadBody: Columns: played, won, drawn, lost, goal difference, goals, form, points. Promotion and relegation zones, when the feed provides them, show as footnotes under the table — DimaScore does not invent competition rules.
botola2Classement.ctaBody: For the full fixture list, open the Matches tab on the Botola 2 competition page.
botola2Classement.followBody: Botola Pro standings have their own page. The Botola Pro competition page and the Morocco edition also cover Moroccan football.
botola2Classement.vsNewsTitle: This page is not an aggregated table
botola2Classement.vsNewsBody: Wikipedia and aggregators publish frozen tables. Here the table is the site’s current-season table ({season}), without odds, and points to Matches for dates.
botola2Classement.faq1q: Where does this table come from?
botola2Classement.faq1a: It is the same Botola 2 table ({season}) as the Standings tab on the competition page.
botola2Classement.faq2q: Is this the Botola Pro table?
botola2Classement.faq2a: No. This page is Botola 2, the second tier. Botola Pro standings have their own landing.
botola2Classement.faq3a: DimaScore does not invent the rules. When the feed provides zones, they appear as footnotes under the table.
botola2Classement.faq4a: On the Matches tab of the Botola 2 competition page.

botolaMatchs.metaTitle: Botola Pro matches & live scores 2026/27 | DimaScore
botolaMatchs.metaDescription: Botola Pro Inwi 2026/27 matches and live scores — today, upcoming and LIVE. Same fixtures as the competition Matches tab. Free, no odds. Cross-links to standings and the calendar.
botolaMatchs.lead: Live Botola Pro Inwi 2026/27 matches and scores — the same source as the Matches tab on the competition page. Free coverage, no betting odds. The default window shows today, upcoming fixtures, and LIVE. For the table, open standings; for the LNFP start date and posters, the 2026/27 calendar.
botolaMatchs.fixturesEmpty: 2026/27 matches will appear here once ingested. If nothing is LIVE, this is not a blank page — follow the next kickoffs.
botolaMatchs.widgetNote: Kickoffs use your device timezone. A 00:00 clock or a clearly wrong date is not an official time — treat it as “kickoff to confirm” until the data updates. DimaScore does not invent kickoff times.
botolaMatchs.howToFollowBody: This list is bound to the 2026/27 season, like the Matches tab on the competition page. LIVE scores update here. When nothing is LIVE, you see today and the next fixtures — not a far-past finished round. Matchday 1 clocks may stay to confirm.
botolaMatchs.ctaBody: The live table has its own page. The LNFP start date and posters are on the 2026/27 calendar. The competition Matches tab remains the single fixtures source.
botolaMatchs.followBody: The Morocco edition and DimaScore home also cover Moroccan football. For Botola 2 matches (second tier), open the Matches tab on the Botola 2 competition page.
botolaMatchs.vsBotola2Body: This page covers Botola Pro only (first tier). Botola 2 matches are on the Botola 2 competition page, Matches tab — not here.
botolaMatchs.faq1q: Where do these matches come from?
botolaMatchs.faq1a: They are the same Botola Pro 2026/27 fixtures as the Matches tab on the competition page.
botolaMatchs.faq2a: If no match is in play, the list shows today and upcoming fixtures. An empty LIVE state is not an error — nothing is currently being played.
botolaMatchs.faq3a: Kickoffs display in your device timezone. Until a time is confirmed in site data, we show “kickoff to confirm”. DimaScore does not invent kickoff times.
botolaMatchs.faq4q: Where can I see the table?
botolaMatchs.faq4a: On the Botola Pro standings landing, and on the Standings tab of the competition page.
